subject.title: docs(gateway): add optional caffeinate-wrapper note to macOS troubleshooting

question: Should the public macOS troubleshooting page recommend an out-of-tree `caffeinate` power-management workaround in addition to the existing upgrade, `pmset`, and liveness-watchdog guidance?
rationale: The codebase supports generic service wrappers, but whether OpenClaw should recommend a persistent sleep-prevention policy for operators is a support and product-boundary choice rather than a mechanical documentation correction.

options.title: Document the supported operator workaround
options.body: Keep the optional section after correcting the wrapper lifecycle explanation and clearly preserve the power-use caveat.

options.title: Keep the current recovery guidance only
options.body: Decline the caffeinate section and retain the existing documented upgrade, `pmset`, and launchd-watchdog steps.

recommendation.title: Document the supported operator workaround
recommendation.body: Keep the optional section after correcting the wrapper lifecycle explanation and clearly preserve the power-use caveat.
